question: Protection against age discrimination at EU level is based primarily on Directive 2000/78/EC, which is limited to the employment sector. Many Europeans nevertheless continue to face age discrimination in other key areas, such as access to healthcare, housing, transport, digital technologies or even financial services.

Does the Commission intend to extend the EU legal framework to ensure effective protection against age discrimination in all areas of social and economic life, and to put forward legislation to this end covering access to goods and services?
